art_direction: Paper-diorama sky: the world reads as layered cut paper lit from one low sun - sage-topped islands with cut-paper cliffs and hard shadows down-right, floating over banded cloud layers against a dusk-blue gradient sky. Identity kit 'paper-diorama'. Everything is flat-shaded low-poly with vertex colours and no textures; the coral marble is the one saturated, glossy thing on the course so it is never lost, gems and the goal gate are marigold, bumpers are teal, checkpoints light sky-blue. UI is cut-paper tabs and cards with irregular edges, marigold buttons and a fibre overlay.

asset.description: The player's glass marble: a faceted coral sphere with a cream swirl band
asset.readability: A coral marble with a cream swirl band whose turning shows the roll direction and speed, readable at 64 px across from the chase camera on sage and paper islands; the most saturated, glossiest thing on the course
asset.spec: Low-poly GLB sphere (about 400 triangles, 0.5 m radius), vertex colours for the swirl band, one glossy material; roll is shown by the band turning

camera: Third-person chase camera about 6 m behind and 3.5 m above the marble, looking 4 m ahead; its yaw follows the direction of travel with damping so drag input never flips; no player camera control. In portrait the field of view widens to keep the next ramp or gap in frame.

palette.role: Background layer: the top of the dusk sky, the dimmer behind cards
Panels, cards, the swirl band of the marble, the goal gate pillars
Primary accent: gems, stars, goal gate banner, primary buttons
The marble (the player); the clock once the run is over par
Island tops (the safe path); positive feedback and new best
Mid sky and cloud layers; a lit checkpoint flag
Warm horizon band and the low sun; fog colour
Bumpers, the only teal in the scene
Low walls and the moving platform slab

avoid: System or default UI fonts (Arial, Roboto, Inter, the browser default)
Rounded white cards with drop shadows as the default container
visual_identity.concept: Layered cut paper lit from one side: soft depth, crisp edges, handmade warmth. Here a diorama of floating sky islands at dusk, with a glass marble as the one bright thing that moves.
visual_identity.motion: Layers slide in with slight parallax; rewards pop up like a pop-up book (scale from a hinge); stars stamp in one by one. In play the marble is smooth 60 fps physics; the camera lags the heading by about 0.3 s.
visual_identity.shape_language: Irregular cut-paper edges on panels and island cliffs, each layer casting a short hard shadow down-right; islands are flat-shaded facets with crisp edges, ramps are clean wedges, the marble is the only smooth round form.
visual_identity.texture: Paper fibre overlay on every paper surface of the UI; none on the 3D meshes, which are flat-shaded vertex colours.

typography.source: Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License; cyrillic in scope (en, ru): Playfair Display for Fraunces, which cover it

button.style: Cut-paper tab with an irregular edge and a short hard shadow down-right; pressed flattens the shadow
